title: Check an identifier map
summary: Check a de-identification map locally before a Release Gate.

sections.use: Place between your local de-identification block and a Release Gate. It checks the map with Restore's own parser, that it is one-to-one, that every original is in the source, every placeholder in the de-identified text, and that no placeholder was already in the source. Bind the Gate's value and scan to its out.
sections.exclusions: It does not look for originals left behind in the text and cannot tell whether the right identifiers were chosen; the Gate review is still required.
sections.effects: Runs locally with no network or model. Every port is Local only because its values include originals; the map never leaves the machine.
sections.limitations: Texts up to 1 MiB and up to 1,000 map entries. Placeholders use [KIND_N] (bracket_upper).
sections.missing_data: An empty map passes. Bracket tokens in the text without a map entry are listed as unmapped_tokens (at most 100).
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.pairs: The identifier map: a JSON list of {placeholder, original} objects.

outputs.out: The text unchanged, the checked pairs, entries, unmapped_tokens and unmapped_truncated.
